name: ClawCredit
summary: Beta credit line for AI agents, underwritten by t54 according to the operator, spendable on x402 services and grown by repaying on time.

overview.text: ClawCredit presents a beta credit line for AI-agent spending on x402 services, underwritten by t54 according to the operator. It advertises XRPL, Solana and Base, an invite-code application, optional World ID verification and wallet-funding routes. Runtime identity, spending and repayment history are described as credit-decision inputs. Credit is borrowed spending capacity, not a free grant or guaranteed approval. Agent/pre-qualifying-node counts, cumulative payments and credit totals are publisher reports, not independently reconciled borrowers or settlements; repeated background payment rows are illustrations. Network and any-x402 claims do not guarantee endpoint acceptance. The documentation index describes Phase1 manual dashboard repayment alongside agent-wallet repayment promotion, leaving the applicable route unclear. Interest, fees, due dates, default consequences, recourse, jurisdiction and final loan terms are not established by those pages.
